thread:
alex: quick ping — PR #3248 (kvcache cleanup) has a couple tiny naming/formatting nits flagged by CI. can someone grab the review?

maria: on it, pinging now. is this safe to land in today's merge window (4pm PT)?

sam: I glanced — mostly varname + one exported comment mismatch. CI linter failing on `ctx` vs `context` convention and a `gofmt` change. nothing behavior-changing.

jen: small clarification: we prefer `requestID` for exported structs, `reqID` is fine for locals. if it's in a public type we should expand.

alex: yep, the public type is in serving/requests.go so we should rename. I can push a tiny follow-up commit if folks are okay.

maria: if it's a single-identifier rename + comment update that's fine. please run `gofmt -w` and `golangci-lint run` locally before pushing. saves CI cycles.

alex: will do. copying snippet I used to test locally:```bash
# format + lint quickcheck
gofmt -w ./...
golangci-lint run --disable-all -E gosimple,govet,staticcheck
```

sam: looks good. for the exported field rename, add a short note in CHANGELOG.md under "internal" so any downstream codegen folks know to re-run.

jen: also update the json/proto tags if present — I found one proto tag still had `req_id` that needs `request_id`.

alex: thanks, will change tags. pushing in ~10m. want to wait for ci-bot green and then merge within the 4pm window. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: build/3248 — fmt check failed (1 file).

alex: pushed fixups. removed `reqID` in serving/requests.go -> `requestID`, updated proto tag and comment, ran gofmt.

ci-bot: build/3248 — running tests...

maria: quick review in the thread: I approve the rename + changelog note. please squash the fixups into the original commit if possible.

sam: approving as well. leaving a minor nit about a comment grammar but not blocking.

ci-bot: build/3248 — all checks passed.

alex: merged into main during the 4pm merge window. thanks everyone for the quick turn-around!

jen: nice, thanks for handling the follow-up.

maria: ":tada:"
